_comment: ACTUAL cost, as billed. Everything the dashboard computes itself is an ESTIMATE: vCPU-hours from Batch job start and stop times times the published Fargate Spot list rate. This file is where a real, billed figure goes, and it is edited by a person because no automation on this account can fetch one.
_why_a_file_and_not_an_api: This AWS account (073795725844) is denied every cost API by an explicit Deny in service control policy p-q1ngvul9 on organisation o-z3xgjt2s3d - Cost Explorer, Budgets, Cost and Usage Reports and the Free Tier API alike. The organisation's management account is 897729121516 (aws-master+ucsd3@strategic-blue.com): this is a CloudBank-funded account billed through Strategic Blue. The denial is deliberate, not a misconfiguration to work around - CloudBank bills at its own negotiated rate, so AWS-side figures would not be what the grant is charged anyway.
_where_to_get_the_number: The CloudBank portal (https://www.cloudbank.org) - sign in and open the account's spend report.
The monthly CloudBank/Strategic Blue invoice email.
Ask the UW research computing contact who administers the CloudBank allocation.
_how_to_record_one: Add an entry to `entries` with the billing period, the amount in USD, and where it came from. The dashboard reads this file on every rebuild: as soon as an entry has a non-null amount it shows the recorded actual alongside the estimate. Leave `amount` null for a period whose invoice has not arrived - a null is not rendered.
